title: NeuronEye: Query-Guided Visual Concept Activation for Vision-Language Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38098v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current vision-language models (VLMs) encode visual information in dense hidden states where object identity, spatial layout, and local attributes are implicitly entangled rather than explicitly disentangled, limiting their ability to isolate and modulate the specific visual evidence required by a given language query. Inspired by sparse population coding and top-down modulation in biological vision, we introduce NeuronEye, a plug-in framework that constructs a sparse, concept-level neuron vocabulary from intermediate VLM representations and selectively activates query-relevant visual concepts during inference. NeuronEye decomposes vision-token states into an overcomplete sparse basis organized by concept-level clusters, uses the language query to activate relevant clusters and localize the patches where selected concepts are expressed, and injects the focused evidence back into vision tokens. translated_title: NeuronEye：面向视觉-语言推理的查询引导式视觉概念激活
translated_abstract: 当前的视觉-语言模型将视觉信息编码在稠密的隐藏状态中，物体身份、空间布局和局部属性被隐式地纠缠在一起而非显式解耦，这限制了模型隔离并调制给定语言查询所需的特定视觉证据的能力。受生物视觉中稀疏群体编码和自上而下调制机制的启发，我们提出了NeuronEye——一个即插即用框架，它从VLM的中间表示中构建稀疏的概念级神经元词表，并在推理过程中选择性地激活与查询相关的视觉概念。NeuronEye将视觉token状态分解为按概念级簇组织的过完备稀疏基，利用语言查询激活相关簇并定位所选概念所表达的图像块，随后将聚焦的证据重新注入视觉token中。一个互补的抑制机制会衰减（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: NeuronEye是一个受生物视觉稀疏编码与自上而下调制机制启发的即插即用框架，通过将视觉表示分解为概念级稀疏神经元词表，并依据语言查询选择性激活和抑制相关视觉概念，实现更精准的视觉-语言推理。
en_tdlr: NeuronEye is a plug-in framework inspired by sparse population coding and top-down modulation in biological vision, which decomposes visual representations into a concept-level sparse neuron vocabulary and selectively activates and suppresses query-relevant visual concepts for more precise vision-language reasoning.
